text: Pressure Lab tropes (GDD 05 §5.3, R5Q3): patterns a run shows, as rules over its features. Features: share.<pool>.<band> (share of squad-ticks), breaks.<pool>, surges.<pool>, band_changes.<pool> (whole run), turns, reason, decided (1 if a side won before the turn limit), vp_gap, value_lost_ratio (the larger side's loss over the smaller's, 1 if none).

tropes.text: Morale barely moves: drift too strong or flows too weak.
Morale swings back and forth across bands.
Nobody gets ahead before the turn limit.
